meta.source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); DGM1 Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung (CC BY 4.0)
meta.crs: EPSG:4326 lng/lat; len and z in metres
meta.slope: mean absolute grade along the edge direction on 9 m-smoothed DGM1, baseline >= 10 m; capped at 25% (slopeSuspect) for non-step edges; tunnels, bridges and indoor ways use the OSM incline tag or 0
meta.vanRules: vehicleAllowed = legal for a 3.5 t van (2.8 m high, 2.2 m wide) on 2026-10-10 (Saturday) at 05:30, incl. barrier nodes; oneway edges are stored in their legal direction (a -> b)

edges.source: VAG notice 27.01.2025 'Lorenzer Passage: Bauarbeiten gehen in die nächste Runde': the station lift only runs platform <-> passage; step-free street access only via the Galeria lift during Galeria opening hours (OSM node 792628472 opening_hours=Mo-Sa 09:30-20:00); renovation until end of 2027
